argv: fixed: fix gaps-done-wait; the draw's tiles were kept from the replay's read (createTileBodies), the journey reloads first (Nov 18)

ops.body: - [loop] The atlas journey's "Cancel goes at once and keeps nothing" (`atlas.js` l.498-528) slows tiles with `tiles.delayMs`, but the look's `readAround` may get every tile from the 16 the area reads kept (`createTileBodies`), so Cancel may land during the compute, not while a read is out. Inferred, not measured (fix gaps-done-wait audit F3, Nov 18): have the harness count the requests it holds under the delay and assert one is held when Cancel is tapped, here and in gaps audit 4.
